<!-- Start with the reader's result and impact. When behavior changes durable user, operator, developer, or maintainer knowledge, describe the affected source or generated output in Outcome or Scope; do not add a documentation checkbox for a change with no reader impact. Keep reviewer actor/context IDs and local run paths in lifecycle state. The author/coordinator fills known contract facts and then actual verification, review, and completion results; draft placeholders are not evidence. List every non-blocking disposition, with an owner and durable HTTPS record for accepted-risk or tracked-follow-up. Producer/intermediate PR: Refs ISSUE, optionally ending in a period. Final verified consumer adoption only: Closes ISSUE, closes OWNER/REPOSITORY#NUMBER, optionally ending in a period, after the completed checklist. -->
## Result

- Outcome: pending <!-- Observable result delivered by this pull request. -->
- Scope: pending <!-- Bounded implementation surfaces changed. -->

## Contract and evidence

- Source: pending <!-- Accepted issue or request URL. -->
- Risk: pending <!-- Consumer-assessed risk. -->
- Compatibility: pending <!-- Compatibility impact and consumer action, or none. -->
- Profiles: pending <!-- Exact canonical profiles that passed. -->
- Snapshot: pending <!-- Reviewed snapshot digest. -->
- Completion receipt: pending <!-- Completion receipt digest, or pending while draft. -->

## Review and completion

- Verdict: pending <!-- Actual independent review outcome, or pending while draft. -->
- Cycles: pending <!-- Review-cycle count. -->
- Blocking findings: pending <!-- Open count and status. -->
- Non-blocking dispositions: pending <!-- Resolution, or owner plus durable HTTPS record. -->
- [ ] Accepted scope is implemented without silent expansion.
- [ ] Required profiles pass on the reviewed snapshot.
- [ ] Independent review approved with no blocking finding.
- [ ] Every non-blocking finding has a recorded disposition.
<!-- engineering-process:pr-description:end -->
